title: Tactical map generation rules
description: Rules for generating a tactical map from the tactical map request (spec TAC-080, TAC-038). Biome → terrain and prefab tables come from STR-095; exit count and exits are specced; the stage slots (terrain, roads, prefab placement, cover scatter, spawns and objectives, validate) come from the workflow and have no design rules yet (TAC open question 51).
$comment: Named constants. Fields are optional until the content pass fills them with the design placeholders listed in the spec.

prefabs.description: prefab placement rules; the prefab table per biome is named by STR-095 (not designed)

exits.description: TAC-038 / TAC-080: exit templates; id is reported back as battle_result soldiers[].exitId

params.description: condition parameters, e.g. boat turn, crossing price
